title: Sunday · the plain bag
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The Plain Bag's Sunday, the week before the dailies: the dog-food bag with no logo, drawn three ways — on the shelf, in the Legacy's back, on the garage floor with the pup's head in it. The letter that asked for the logo: reserved. The bag: plain.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a plain brown bag of dog food on a grocery shelf between two branded ones, its face blank.

image.prompt: a plain brown paper bag of dog food with no logo on a grocery shelf between two branded bags, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Shelf

panels.composition: Tier 2: the bag in a station wagon's back, the pup's nose over the seat at it.

image.prompt: a plain brown dog-food bag in the back of a station wagon with a small three-legged dog's nose coming over the seat toward it, watercolor

panels.name: Car

panels.composition: Tier 3: the bag on the garage floor, open, the pup's whole head in it, the lamp.

image.prompt: a plain brown dog-food bag open on a garage floor with a small three-legged dog's whole head inside it, a lamp lit above, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Floor

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The letter: reserved. The bag: plain.
